failure_summary.description: Explicit follow-up criteria were ignored, sent to the wrong action, or accompanied by unnecessary work on unchanged domains.
Generated search or filter results were not saved to cache.
An import from a nonexistent tools module caused execution to fail.
A flight class value used title case instead of the schema-accepted lowercase choice, causing a runtime error.

patch.reasoning: Most observed problems are already covered by the skill, so the patch avoids repeating cache-write and no-import instructions. It clarifies how to handle a newly completed pending search, distinguishes neighborhood preferences from proximity requests, and resolves ambiguity about accepted flight-class casing.

edits.target: If the user adds criteria, retrieve the closest compatible result, apply the matching filter, and save the updated result.
edits.content: If a later reply supplies the missing required inputs for a previously requested but not-yet-searched domain, perform that pending search in the same turn; do not refresh or transform domains whose criteria are unchanged.

edits.target: - For recommendations near another result type, ensure compatible results for both types are available, then call `search_nearest` and save its result. Set `groupBy` to the domain the user wants as the organizing base; when lodging is the planned base, group by hotel.
edits.content: - For recommendations near another result type, first apply any newly stated criteria to the compatible current results for each participating domain, then call `search_nearest` with those updated results and save its output. A preference to stay in a named neighborhood is a domain location criterion, not a proximity request: apply it through the supported `neighborhood` field, and call `search_nearest` only when proximity is requested. Set `groupBy` to the domain the user wants as the organizing base; when lodging is the planned base, group by hotel.

edits.target: For flights, pass an explicitly provided airport code in the corresponding `start_airport_code` or `end_airport_code` field; do not substitute it for a city or airport-name value.
edits.content: For `flight_class`, use the schema's lowercase choices: `"economy"`, `"business"`, or `"first"`, even if the user or an example uses different casing.
